nodes.label: Git Index Lock Clearing Rule
nodes.rationale: Michael's Windows checkout repeatedly leaves behind a stale .git/index.lock that blocks git add/commit/push; manually deleting it hasn't stuck (it recurs). Per Michael (2026-08-17), every PowerShell git command sequence given to him must therefore prepend a line removing the lock file (Remove-Item -Force .git\index.lock -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) before add/commit/push, every time rather than only after an error has already appeared. The same rule applies in the sibling pokemart-api repo.

nodes.label: R2-Only Image Hosting Rule
nodes.rationale: Every image URL used on the site must be hosted on Cloudflare R2 (bucket pokebulkcards, CDN https://images.pokebulk.co.za), never an external hotlink (e.g. TCGCSV, Google Images, Bulbapedia). Per Michael (2026-08-08): 'yes r2 always for images, set in rules!' Upload is primarily a backend (pokemart-api) concern, but the frontend must never build a feature that displays an image straight from an external URL passthrough, and should always expect API-provided image URLs to already be R2 URLs, flagging any new backend field that isn't.

nodes.label: Next.js Breaking-Changes Notice
nodes.rationale: This project's Next.js version has breaking changes relative to standard training-data knowledge, so agents must read the relevant guide in node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing code and heed deprecation notices, to avoid producing code that assumes familiar-but-outdated Next.js APIs or conventions.
